newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank hikes bank, deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank hikes bank, deposit rates.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, on Thursday raised bank rates to 7.0 percent from 6.5 percent and lifted interest rates on deposits in a move to curb credit expansion.
Central bank officials said the minimum interest rates on savings deposit was raised to 6.5 percent from 6.0 percent and on fixed deposit to 6.75 percent from 6.25 percent.
"The move has been taken to increase mobilisation of savings and restrict credit expansion. This will also help more efficient use of credit," said one official.
The officials said the step had also been taken to reduce inflationery pressure on the economy.
